description: Use this for adverse media / negative news screening of a person or company (KYB, KYC, vendor due diligence). Searches public news editions (GB/US/SG/IN/AU/CA/IE/AE/IL/NZ) for the name plus risk terms and classifies headlines into FATF-style categories (financial_crime, sanctions_export, regulatory, legal, insolvency, cyber_data, esg_labour, terrorism_organised). Returns risk_level, risk_score 0-100, category counts and dated articles with URLs. Screening aid, not an AML determination. Example: {name:"Wirecard"}. $0.25 USDC.
name: adverse_media
